query:
SELECT
            p.slug AS "slug: Slug",
            p.name,
            EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM auth_oauth2_provider_credentials c
                WHERE c.provider_id = p.id
                    AND c.user_id = $1
                    AND c.disconnected_at IS NULL
            ) AS "connected!"
        FROM auth_oauth2_providers o
        JOIN auth_providers p ON p.id = o.provider_id
        ORDER BY p.name
